command:
set -eu
printf 'node=%s ip=%s\n' "$NODE_NAME" "$NODE_IP"
cat /etc/os-release
uname -r
printf '%s\n' '--- boot identity ---'
cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
printf '%s\n' '--- crypto tooling ---'
command -v openssl || true
openssl version 2>/dev/null || true
printf '%s\n' '--- trust tooling ---'
command -v update-ca-trust || true
update-ca-trust check 2>&1 || true
printf '%s\n' '--- existing matching anchors ---'
find /etc/pki/ca-trust/source/anchors -maxdepth 1 -type f -print 2>/dev/null | sort | while IFS= read -r f; do openssl x509 -in "$f" -noout -subject 2>/dev/null | grep -F 'OS Comparison Root CA' && printf 'file=%s\n' "$f" || true; done
printf '%s\n' '--- system health ---'
systemctl is-system-running 2>&1 || true
systemctl --failed --no-legend --no-pager 2>&1 || true
